name: Logout Jump Button
description: Animated log out button where a little figure walks to a door, slams it, and falls away, then the button resets. Available in a dark and a light look.
contents: Animated door and walking figure icons
behavior: Click triggers walk, door slam, a spinning fall and a reset after about 3 seconds
Clicks are ignored while the animation plays
editableByProps: Button, text, door and figure colors

needsCodeEdit.where: w-[130px] and h-[40px] classes on the button

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Button is a fixed 130px by 40px size
Uses Quicksand font family without importing it, falls back to sans-serif
Renders nothing until mounted on the client

options.look: Dark button with light text and door
options.useWhen: Placing the button on a light page or header

options.look: Light button with dark text and door
options.useWhen: Placing the button on a dark page or dark sidebar
